name: Pool Hall Alex
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pool Hall Alex in Imst**

Welcome to **Pool Hall Alex** in the heart of **Imst**, where billiards, fun, and good times come together! Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, our cozy atmosphere and top-quality tables make every game an experience.

After a round of pool, relax with friends over a cold drink or enjoy a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** at our café. The perfect mix of sport, leisure, and local charm—just like **Tirol** itself!

Come by and see why **Pool Hall Alex** is a favorite spot in **Imst**! 🎱✨
